title: reminder_policy.docx
text:
Harborview Animal Hospital - Reminder and estimate policy

Recall reminders: text first, then email after 3 days, then a phone call after 7 days. Maximum three contacts per vaccine.

Rabies is legally required in our county; overdue rabies reminders take priority over DHPP and FVRCP.

Booking link for vaccine appointments: harborviewvet.example.com/book. Saturday vaccine clinic runs 9am to 1pm.

Estimates: front desk may quote exam fees ($68) and vaccine fees (rabies $32, DHPP $38, FVRCP $36). Surgery and dental estimates only from Dr. Raman or Dr. Okafor.

Insurance claims: return completed forms within 3 business days. Trupanion claims can be submitted direct via Trupanion Express.
